svg.title: Window function: the same groups, but no rows disappear
svg.desc: The same 8 flights are partitioned by carrier. AVG(dep_delay) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier) computes each carrier's average, 6 for AA, 17.5 for DL, and 7.75 for UA, and writes it on every row of that carrier. All 8 rows remain in the result.
svg.text: Window function: the same groups, but no rows disappear
PARTITION BY forms the same groups as GROUP BY. The average is attached to every row instead of replacing them.
Each row keeps its own dep_delay and gains
Compare GROUP BY, which returned 3 rows.
